references.title: DWDS: gar
references.supports: ²gar, Adverb, sense I.1 'verstärkt eine Verneinung: überhaupt'; Grundform ¹gar, the adjective; no Wortzerlegung

notes.rationale: Du glaubst gar nicht, 'at all'. DWDS derives the adverb from the adjective gar with no affix, but a Source is given only to NOUN, VERB and ADJ (ADR 0050), so the adverb is a bottom word, indeclinable, with no Ending (ADR 0051): the Root gar alone.
